name: ChatWidget
description: Collapsible site assistant chat widget with streaming replies.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-14 — streaming display reviewed: only the active assistant reply uses grapheme-safe adaptive smoothing; reduced motion bypasses it and the polite message log remains aria-busy until the complete response is available.
